items.title: Passengers thought mass train attack 'was a joke'
items.summary: The first person who was attacked also says he asked hospital staff "am I going to die today?".

items.title: Briton with Ebola 'to be treated in UK'
items.summary: A British healthcare worker in the Democratic Republic of Congo has tested positive for Ebola and will reportedly be treated in the UK.

items.title: Time to focus on cost of living, says PM after US election results
items.summary: Andy Burnham says prices won't come down until the US's conflict with Iran is resolved.

items.title: Goalkeeper involved in collision with Spanish footballer who died releases statement
items.summary: A goalkeeper involved in an on-field collision with a Spanish footballer who died says he is "going through the most difficult ‌days of his life".

items.title: UK national tests positive for Ebola virus in DR Congo
items.summary: A British government spokesperson says the risk to the UK public from Ebola remains low.

items.title: Husband who drugged and raped wife was 'monster' who lived 'double life'
items.summary: A husband who drugged and raped his wife for 21 years was a 'monster' who lived a double life, a court has heard.
